# Agent Readiness Audit

`agent-readiness-audit` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · SEO, GEO & AEO
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/agent-readiness-audit/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Can an AI agent buying for a customer read, compare and transact with us today, and what blocks it first?

**Inputs:** The site's rendering method, what structured data exists, whether pricing and specs are published, what actions can complete without a human, and the robots.txt stance on AI crawlers

**Output:** A readiness score across five dimensions, the hard blockers named first, gaps ranked by cost, a plain statement of what an agent can and cannot do today, and the fixes in order

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill agent-readiness-audit`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/agent-readiness-audit/resources/agent-readiness.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/agent-readiness-audit/resources/agent-readiness.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It is a self-assessment, not a crawl. It scores the flags you pass and cannot check the live site; verify each answer with view-source or curl.
- Each check is pass or fail, so a half-done item scores nothing. Rendering is a hard gate: without --ssr the verdict is BLOCKED whatever else passes.
- It measures whether an agent can evaluate and act, not whether AI engines cite you. Use seo-geo-aeo-audit for that.
- Input it doesn't recognise returns the worked example rather than an error; check the result reflects your data. It reads flags only, so JSON input shows the nothing-passing demo.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the website verifies each flag against the live site (raw HTML, robots.txt, a no-login purchase path), and the founder makes the published-pricing and AI-crawler decisions explicitly before fixes are scheduled.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/agent-readiness-audit](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/agent-readiness-audit)
